honesty_note: The Poissonnier 2026 open-arena outcomes and the frozen failures of H2-v1, H3-v1, and H4-v1 were known before H5 was drafted. Bonavita et al. 2026 Lasius niger search-behaviour results were also considered. This is outcome-aware mechanism design, not preregistration. The biological mechanism is now frozen after pre-implementation stress audits, but the estimator policy remains unfrozen; H5 runtime implementation and parameter search remain forbidden until that policy is frozen.
working_claim: Shorter recent constrained travel leaves a stronger area-restricted search tendency relative to the ant's trial origin. At ordinary major reorientation events, that tendency increases the probability of drawing a new direction from an origin-oriented circular distribution. Longer constrained travel weakens that search component and permits more direct outward dispersal. H5 does not directly change speed, global angular-noise magnitude, reorientation-event hazard, pause behavior, entry heading, or arena-edge/centerline attraction.

why_H5_is_substantively_different.H2: H2 changed the magnitude of spatially homogeneous continuous angular diffusion. H5 adds spatially contingent directional information relative to a trial origin.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H3: H3 changed the timing/frequency of reorientation events while leaving conditional turn direction unbiased. H5 keeps the H3-null event timing law and changes only the conditional directional distribution at those events.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H4: H4 changed moving speed only and left trajectory steering unchanged. H5 leaves moving speed unchanged and changes the distribution from which a post-reorientation direction is selected.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H1: H1 is an entry-state explanation. H5 may use a shared measured or reconstructed trial origin as geometry, but may not assign treatment-specific entry heading, speed, position, or geometry distributions. Any measurement reconstruction must be frozen separately and applied identically to H5-null and H5-context.

poissonnier_control_pattern.straightness_path_length_effect: significant; short-path ants were less linear
poissonnier_control_pattern.moving_speed_path_length_effect: not statistically significant in the publication; short-path mean about 23.5 mm/s and long-path mean about 26 mm/s
poissonnier_control_pattern.interpretation: The strongest published signal is geometric: short-path ants wander farther and less linearly before reaching an edge. Speed-only H4 helped timing in some folds but did not generalize or solve spatial geometry.

frozen_internal_cv_history.H2: failed its frozen held-out promotion guard
frozen_internal_cv_history.interpretation: No spatially homogeneous one-primitive history effect generalized across colonies. H5 therefore tests spatial feedback rather than a stronger version of H2, H3, or H4.

Bonavita_et_al_2026.paper: Discovering search behaviour in black garden ant trajectories
Bonavita_et_al_2026.relevance: In Lasius niger released into an open arena, segment-level movement statistics depended on heading relative to the starting point, and simulations of those dependencies generated area-restricted search around the start.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.important_scope_limit: Those ants were passively transported/released in a different context. The paper supports origin-referenced search as a plausible representation, not the specific claim that 200 versus 1000 mm prior constrained walking modulates its strength in the Poissonnier assay.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.parameter_limit: The paper does not provide an independently validated single radial-scale parameter that can simply be imported as r_search_mm for H5.

Poissonnier_et_al_2026.relevance: Longer prior travel produced more linear subsequent walking while trail-following accuracy was unchanged, and Lasius niger can discriminate travel distances in this range.
Poissonnier_et_al_2026.scope_limit: This motivates a locomotion/search hypothesis but does not establish H5.

measurement_reconstruction_dependency.published_beeline_definition_verified: Beeline equals Euclidean distance from measured first tracked position (Xstart,Ystart) to measured final position (Xlast,Ylast) for all 51 DCM-control rows to floating-point tolerance.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.current_simulator_mismatch: The current assay simulation uses nominal 297 x 210 mm A4 geometry and approximately 0.5 mm entry-position jitter around the geometric center. The published Beeline uses measured first-track coordinates and per-video tracked arena bounds, which vary from those nominal assumptions.

treatment_position_audit.interpretation: Measured start positions should not be ignored, but the available table does not provide compelling evidence for a treatment-specific start-position mechanism.

measurement_reconstruction_dependency.forbidden_resolution: Do not create separate short-versus-long entry-position or arena-geometry distributions merely because they improve H5 fit.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.selected_resolution: For each LOCO fold, sample complete empirical geometry rows uniformly with replacement from the five training colonies only, pooled across path lengths, using the dedicated poissonnier2026_measurement_geometry_v1 input RNG stream. Apply the same geometry draws to short/long, null/context, and matched comparator re-evaluations.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.measurement_vs_biology_boundary: first_track_position defines the observation start and Beeline start. The central entry reference represents the physical hole/trail crossing. This measurement policy does not decide which is the biological H5 search origin.

allowed_biological_inputs: recent_constrained_travel_mm (H5-v1 supported only at exact values 200 or 1000 mm)
forbidden_inputs: reference metric values as direct model inputs
colony identity as a biological control input
pheromone presence or central-trail identity in the DCM H5 fit
identity of the eventual exit edge

candidate_mechanism.origin: Frozen O = the central physical entry-hole/trail-crossing reference supplied by the measurement geometry row (entry_reference_x_mm, entry_reference_y_mm). The simulated ant still begins observation at first_track_x_mm/first_track_y_mm. First-track position is not the biological H5 origin and may not be substituted after seeing model performance.
candidate_mechanism.history_search_drive: Frozen only at the two observed support points. Define alpha_history(200)=alpha_search_200 and alpha_history(1000)=alpha_search_1000 with 0 <= alpha_search_1000 <= alpha_search_200 <= 1. H5-v1 is undefined for other recent_constrained_travel_mm values and must reject them rather than interpolate/extrapolate. There is no lambda_search_mm, separate rho_search, or temporal decay parameter.
candidate_mechanism.radial_gate: Frozen R(X,O,arena): if r=||X-O|| is 0 then R=0; otherwise let d_edge be the positive distance from O to the sampled rectangular arena boundary along the ray through X and set R=clamp(r/d_edge,0,1). This gate is dimensionless and has no fitted radial scale.
candidate_mechanism.mixture_weight: Frozen structural form w = alpha_history(L) * R(X,O,arena), constrained to [0,1], where alpha_history is defined only at L=200 or 1000 and R is the frozen parameter-free boundary-normalized linear radial gate.

reorientation_effect.baseline_component: Use the ordinary H3-null post-reorientation directional law and existing H3 turn-angle RNG stream.
reorientation_effect.search_component: Frozen: draw a direction symmetrically around the bearing from current position to O using the dedicated H5 search-angle stream and the exact same candidate turn_concentration kappa_turn used by the ordinary H3-null baseline reorientation component. No separate H5 search concentration exists.
reorientation_effect.mixture_rule: At each baseline major reorientation event, draw a dedicated H5 choice variate u. If u < w use the search component; otherwise use the already-drawn baseline component.
reorientation_effect.event_timing: Frozen: event times are generated entirely by the H3-null continuous-time event process. H5-v1 does not alter mean_free_path_mm, event hazard, threshold integration, or event timing.
reorientation_effect.antipodal_rule: When the origin is exactly behind the ant, H5 remains a symmetric mixture distribution and does not choose an arbitrary deterministic left-versus-right mean turn.
reorientation_effect.origin_rule: At r=0, the frozen boundary-normalized radial gate gives R=0 and therefore w=0. Any inert H5 search-angle draw must not influence the selected baseline trajectory.
reorientation_effect.free_path: Frozen absent in H5-v1: no origin-relative or history-dependent free-path modulation. Any such mechanism requires a later separately versioned hypothesis or direct raw-trajectory discriminator.
reorientation_effect.dispersion_rule: Frozen shared-dispersion rule: kappa_search = kappa_turn by identity for every candidate. H5-v1 contains no independent kappa_search field or parameter.

rng_candidate.cadence_rule: Frozen cadence contract for H5-v1 implementation: H5-null, equal-strength common-search, and history-modulated context evaluations consume the dedicated H5 choice/search streams with matched event cadence so differences cannot arise from unrelated RNG shifting. Existing H3 event-threshold and turn-angle streams remain untouched by H5 dedicated draws.

candidate_mechanism.speed: Frozen absent: no direct moving-speed effect in H5-v1.
candidate_mechanism.pause: Frozen absent: no direct pause-hazard or pause-duration effect in H5-v1.
candidate_mechanism.entry_state: No direct alteration of initial heading, initial speed, or initial position by H5 biology.

rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.name: signed_error_mean_shift
rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.reason: Real-Chromium stress testing exposed a circular branch-cut discontinuity at the antipodal configuration; infinitesimal heading perturbations can flip a large commanded turn from one side to the other.

rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.name: circular_vector_mean_blend
rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.reason: The vector resultant becomes degenerate for antipodal directions at a 50/50 blend and the selected mean direction jumps by approximately pi across that point.

candidate_baseline_family.preferred_representation: Reuse the already audited continuous-time run-and-reorientation machinery from H3 as a locomotion substrate with the H3 history-dependent hazard gate disabled. H5-v1's history effect is solely the conditional directional mixture at baseline event times. Baseline mean free path and baseline turn concentration may be shared nuisance parameters, but H5 has no separate free-path, hazard, or search-dispersion effect.
candidate_baseline_family.reason: This reuses audited sub-step event timing and separates H5's new biological claim from the failed H3 history-hazard claim.
candidate_baseline_family.warning: Reusing H3 event machinery is not a rescue of H3-v1. H3's history-dependent reorientation hazard remains failed and must stay disabled.

stress_tested_invariants_for_candidate_m: Rotation of both origin and trajectory frame leaves the directional mixture unchanged up to the same rotation.
Reflection around the outward axis produces a reflected distribution rather than an arbitrary preferred turn side.
Representing an antipodal origin bearing as +pi versus -pi does not create a material distribution discontinuity.
w=0 gives the exact baseline distribution.
r=0 gives w=0 and no origin singularity.
Translating an off-center synthetic origin translates the search reference; the rule does not remain tied to arena center.
Dedicated H5 choice/search RNG streams do not perturb the existing H3 turn-angle stream.
No H5 runtime implementation was used to obtain these stress results.
draft_structural_predictions: For matched baseline parameters and geometry, short-history ants should have a larger probability than long-history ants that a major reorientation is drawn from the origin-oriented component.
The treatment effect should depend jointly on current radial position relative to O and recent constrained travel, not merely on elapsed time.

Short-history ants should accumulate more path length and take longer to reach an arena edge primarily through origin-referenced search, without requiring a direct reduction in instantaneous moving speed.
Long-history ants should disperse outward more directly because the origin-oriented mixture component is weaker.
The origin-oriented component is rotationally symmetric around O and therefore predicts no intrinsic left/right/top/bottom exit preference in a symmetric arena.
H5 predicts no direct attraction to the DCM centerline; central-zone differences must emerge indirectly from geometry and trajectories.
With alpha_search_200=0 and alpha_search_1000=0, H5 reduces exactly to the H3-null locomotion substrate for the same shared measurement geometry and matched baseline random streams.
H5-v1 makes no prediction for recent constrained travel distances other than exactly 200 mm and 1000 mm; such generalization requires a separately justified/versioned history-response law.
If alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000>0, H5 predicts common origin-referenced search but no recent-travel history modulation; this submodel cannot support the H5 history-modulation claim.

identifiability_warnings.history_levels: Resolved for H5-v1 by refusing to estimate a continuous curve shape. The assay supplies only L=200 and L=1000, so H5 reports directly identifiable effective search amplitudes at those support points.
identifiability_warnings.stress_result: Endpoint-matched direct, exponential, and reciprocal representations produced exact matched trajectories at L=200 and L=1000 while disagreeing at unobserved distances. A fitted lambda_search_mm would therefore be a nonlinear transformation of the endpoint ratio, not independently validated curve shape.
identifiability_warnings.radial_scale: Resolved for H5-v1: no r_search_mm or radial-shape parameter will be estimated. The radial gate is frozen to the parameter-free boundary-normalized linear fraction r/d_edge.
reporting_if_ever_fit: Predicted number/proportion of origin-oriented reorientations under each observed history
identifiability_warnings.claim_rule: Do not report lambda_search_mm, a travel-distance half-life, interpolation, or extrapolation from H5-v1. A common-search solution alpha200≈alpha1000 is evidence, at most, for origin-referenced search and not for history modulation.
identifiability_warnings.history_null_structure: Because generic origin-referenced search is externally plausible, H5-v1 must distinguish a shared positive origin-search component from a true recent-travel modulation. The history-modulation null is alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000, not only alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000=0.
identifiability_warnings.search_dispersion: Resolved for H5-v1 by sharing baseline H3 kappa_turn exactly. A separate search concentration is forbidden because alpha_history * R * A1(kappa_search) creates an amplitude-dispersion tradeoff and the aggregate targets contain no direct angular-dispersion statistic.
identifiability_warnings.kappa_zero_boundary: If the shared baseline kappa_turn reaches 0, the origin-search component is uniform and alpha_search_200/1000 do not create directional origin pull. The frozen estimator policy must report or guard this behaviorally degenerate boundary before any H5 mechanism claim.
identifiability_warnings.tiny_positive_kappa_numerics: The frozen H3 von Mises sampler showed convergence failures at kappa=1e-8 and 1.1e-8 near its <1e-8 uniform branch. The estimator policy must avoid arbitrary tiny-positive candidates around that seam or require separately versioned H3 hardening.

raw_trajectory_discriminators_if_recover: post-reorientation heading conditional on bearing to the trial origin
probability that a reorientation is origin-oriented as a function of boundary-normalized radial fraction
free-path length conditional on heading toward versus away from the trial origin
radial displacement from origin as a function of time
number and timing of returns toward the origin neighborhood
short-versus-long differences in those origin-referenced quantities
moving speed conditioned on radial heading, diagnostic only under the current movement-classifier firewall
negative_controls: No history-dependent change to global angular_sigma_rad_sqrt_s.
No history-dependent change to reorientation-event hazard.
No treatment-specific entry heading, entry speed, entry position, or arena-bound distribution.
No centerline, pheromone, exit-edge, or arena-boundary targeting.
No Y-maze access for development fitting, ranking, stopping, or model selection.
No origin-relative or history-dependent modulation of mean free path or reorientation-event hazard in H5-v1.
No fitted or treatment-specific radial-search length scale; H5-v1 radial gating is fixed by sampled arena geometry.
No lambda_search_mm, separate rho_search amplitude, or interpolation/extrapolation to unobserved travel distances in H5-v1.
A common origin-search effect alpha_search_200 = alpha_search_1000 does not by itself support the history-modulation claim.
No H5-specific, history-specific, treatment-specific, radial-specific, or separately fitted search-direction concentration; search dispersion exactly shares baseline H3 kappa_turn.
allowed_shared_measurement_or_geometry_i: first_tracked_position_mm (observation initialization and Beeline start only; not H5 biological origin)

biological_origin_decision.protocol_reason: The ant physically emerges through the central hole onto the arena. The first tracked coordinate is a later observation coordinate and remains the measurement/Beeline start only.
biological_origin_decision.representation_reason: Origin-referenced search should be tied to the physical trial start, not to an observer-dependent first-detected frame.
biological_origin_decision.first_track_position_role: observation initialization and published-style Beeline start only; forbidden as the H5 biological origin
biological_origin_decision.caveat: The observed simulation starts at the first tracked position, already displaced from the central origin. The short unobserved center-hole-to-first-track segment is not replayed. If a later H5 formulation introduces temporal decay, biological time zero and any unobserved delay must be resolved before freezing that decay law.

temporal_drive_decision.rule: For fixed recent_constrained_travel_mm L, the H5 history search drive does not decay with elapsed observed arena time. H5-v1 has no tau_search_s parameter.
temporal_drive_decision.reason: The biological origin is the central physical entry point but observation begins later at first_track_position. The elapsed center-hole-to-first-track interval is unobserved. A temporal decay would therefore introduce an unidentified pre-track time offset exactly confounded with decay amplitude; very slow decay approaches the constant model while adding a weakly identified parameter.

effect_scope_decision.rule: H5-v1 changes only the conditional post-reorientation direction distribution at ordinary H3-null event times. It does not change mean free path, reorientation hazard, or event timing.
effect_scope_decision.baseline_freepath_role: A shared baseline mean_free_path_mm may remain a nuisance parameter of the H3-null substrate, but H5 biology may not modulate it by history, origin-relative heading, radial position, or treatment.
effect_scope_decision.freepath_external_evidence: Bonavita et al. 2026 reported origin-relative free-path anisotropy in Lasius niger, but that mechanism is deferred from H5-v1 because the current aggregate Poissonnier targets do not separately identify it from direction steering.

radial_gate_decision.rule: Let r=||X-O||. If r=0, R=0. Otherwise let d_edge be the distance from O to the sampled rectangular arena boundary along the ray from O through X, and set R=clamp(r/d_edge,0,1).
radial_gate_decision.reason: The provisional rational family r/(r+r_search_mm) behaved largely as an amplitude-rescaling degree of freedom over baseline event locations and aggregate observables. The boundary-normalized linear rule is continuous, symmetry/scale invariant, adapts to each sampled arena, reaches 0 at the physical origin and 1 at the boundary, and removes the weakly identified r_search_mm.

history_response_decision.rule: For L=200 use alpha_search_200; for L=1000 use alpha_search_1000. Any other recent_constrained_travel_mm is outside H5-v1's scientific domain and must hard-fail rather than interpolate or extrapolate.
history_response_decision.curve_claim: H5-v1 makes no claim about the history-response shape between or outside the two observed distances.

null_structure.history_modulation_null: alpha_search_200 = alpha_search_1000, including positive common origin-search strength
null_structure.claim_guard: Evidence against the exact zero-search null alone is not sufficient to claim history modulation. A later frozen estimator must explicitly compare against or strictly guard against the equal-strength common-origin-search submodel.

search_dispersion_decision.rule: The origin-search component and ordinary H3-null reorientation component use the exact same candidate baseline turn_concentration kappa_turn. H5-v1 has no separate search-specific concentration or dispersion parameter.
search_dispersion_decision.nuisance_coupling: If the later frozen estimator varies baseline kappa_turn, both mixture components use that same candidate value.
search_dispersion_decision.reason: A free search-specific kappa trades strongly with alpha_search_200/alpha_search_1000 in circular-moment structure and aggregate trajectory effects, while no independently validated search-specific kappa is available for the Poissonnier assay.
search_dispersion_decision.kappa_zero_guard: At kappa_turn=0 both directional laws are uniform, so positive alpha values do not create origin steering; the estimator policy must not count this behaviorally degenerate boundary as support for H5 history modulation.
search_dispersion_decision.tiny_positive_sampler_seam: The current frozen H3 sampler failed in stress at kappa=1e-8 and 1.1e-8 near its uniform-approximation branch threshold. The estimator policy must avoid that tiny-positive seam or require a separately versioned H3 hardening before search.

estimator_policy_decision.primary_history_guard: H5_history must beat H5_common_search in at least 5 of 6 LOCO folds with strictly positive median relative held-out improvement.
estimator_policy_decision.exact_null_guard: H5_history must also beat H5_null in at least 5 of 6 folds with strictly positive median relative held-out improvement.
estimator_policy_decision.search_method: deterministic Halton low-discrepancy search with exact nesting anchors
estimator_policy_decision.geometry_rule: Use frozen reconstructed measurement geometry with held-out-colony geometry excluded from simulated training and held-out trial pools.
estimator_policy_decision.cross_family_rule: Re-evaluate frozen H2/H3/H4 fold candidates under the same reconstructed geometry and matched held-out scoring without refitting.
